externalMonitor.note: The real monitoring instance outside the Runner fault domain (instance, owner, network, persistence) is an unprovided input; nothing is invented here. A co-hosted monitor can prove process failure only and dies with the host (fault-domain-policy.json).

onCall.note: Names, backup persons and channels must be registered before unattended release can be enabled; this task implies no notification-send authorization.

isolationOperationAuthorization.note: Isolation emergency-action authorization belongs to the platform/knowledge-permission on-call owners and must be registered separately.

deliveryAuthorization.basis: The current task implies no notification-send authorization; delivery stays PREPARE_ONLY until a separately recorded owner approval exists.

unattendedRelease.note: Unregistered external monitor, on-call or backup channel blocks the unattended-release precondition (pre-enable gate, fail-closed).
